violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED ONIONS AT 120F IN THE STEAM WELL.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED ONIONS TO 165F+ DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS HOT HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SLICED CHEESE AT 44F AND SHREDDED CHEESE MIX AT 50-52F IN THE 1-DOOR UNDER-COUNTER COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION TO ANOTHER COOLER AND UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD ALWAYS BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE LEAVE DINING AREA TO GRILL BURGERS BEGIN PUTTING ON GLOVES WITHOUT WASHING HANDS.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE AND DISCARD GLOVES; WASH AND DRY HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES. EMPLOYEE COMPLIED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BLANCHED POTATOES AT 50F ON TRUE 2 DOOR PREP TOP (FRYERS)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER POTATOES TO INSIDE PREP TOP OR WALK IN REFRIGERATOR DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: CARAMELIZED ONIONS, BRISKET AND BEEF BROTH IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY LABLES WITH APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION.
